description: This Java source file defines the SamplingServiceFactory class responsible for managing sampling services based on class context and configuration. It creates and retrieves sampling service instances, either real or no-op, depending on configuration, and allows performing operations over all services.

classes.name: SamplingServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing SamplingService instances based on class context and sampling configuration.

methods.name: forClass
methods.description: Returns a SamplingService instance for the given class, creating a new one if necessary, based on sampling configuration.

methods.name: doWithAll
methods.description: Executes a given Consumer with a copy of the current services map, allowing operations over all managed sampling services.
